title: Deshaun Watson outplays Shedeur Sanders in preseason opener, but Browns QB battle leaves plenty to be desired

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Deshaun Watson outplays Shedeur Sanders in preseason opener, but Browns QB battle leaves plenty to be desired
sources.description: Watson started strong before a strip sack derailed his afternoon, while Sanders threw an ugly interception on his third and final drive
